sentences.en: He makes himself accessible to all who seek his counsel.
sentences.zh: 他向所有寻求建议的人敞开自己。

sentences.en: To those who seek peace and security: We support you.
sentences.zh: 向那些寻求和平与安全的人：我们支持你们。

sentences.en: Believe those who seek truth, beware those who find it.
sentences.zh: 相信寻求真理的人，提防那些已经找到它的人。
